newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-KPN sees no rating impact from TNT.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-KPN sees no rating impact from TNT.

text.p: Dutch telecoms and postal group Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV (KPN) said on Wednesday it did not expect the purchase of Australian transport group TNT Ltd would affect its credit rating.
The Dutch company also said at a news conference here that the TNT purchase should be slightly earnings positive in calendar 1997.
"For 1997, we are expecting a slightly positive effect," KPN chief executive Vim Dik said when asked about the earnings effect of KPN's planned A$2.0 billion takeover of TNT.

"We do not expect (the takeover) to have any effect on our (credit) ratings," Dik said when asked about the potential effect on KPN's long term AA plus and A1 plus short term credit rating assigned to it by ratings agency Standard & Poor's Corp.
